decisive_items: bilateral adrenal and periaortic retroperitoneal masses
sparse perivascular and interstitial infiltrate of enlarged atypical mononuclear cells in the reticular dermis and subcutis
response.rationale: R3 is the champion because it has more comprehensive support from the vignette, including the presence of atypical mononuclear cells and lymphadenopathy, which suggests a lymphoproliferative disorder. C1 is the runner-up because it is an append-only completion of R3 and has similar support from the vignette, but lacks the direct evidence of lymphoma.

rejected.why: lacks direct evidence of lymphoma and is an append-only completion of R3
